purpose: Curated public population references, NOT personal financial defaults or projections.

observations.population: Employees in the private sector, full-time equivalent; net of social contributions, not necessarily after personal income tax.
observations.mapping_reason: The planner asks for monthly cash income after income tax and possible non-salary income; this median is an equivalent full-time wage before household income tax adjustment.

observations.population: People in ordinary housing in metropolitan France: median equivalised disposable income, expressed for a one-person household.
observations.mapping_reason: Equivalised disposable living standard is not an individual's salary nor automatically the planner's household cash income.

observations.population: Vietnam population, mean monthly income per person, 2025 household living standards preliminary survey.
observations.source_name: National Statistics Office of Vietnam, 2025 preliminary results
observations.mapping_reason: Mean per-person income is neither median nor a household's after-tax cash income.

observations.population: Vietnam population, mean total expenditure per person monthly, approximately 3 million VND in 2024; this is not a household budget.
observations.source_name: National Statistics Office of Vietnam, 2024 household survey press release
observations.mapping_reason: Per-capita average spending is not a household monthly spending amount.
